subject: R Crashing in Yosemite OS X

messages.author: bf8580fbf64e28d0
messages.subject: R Crashing in Yosemite OS X
parts:
Has anyone else been having problems with R crashing on Yosemite OS X? It's starting to drive me crazy! I'm using the regular install of R and it works fine until I go to open an R document and then I get a blank open file window, a pinwheel, and the only remedy is to force quit. So it seems opening documents is what kills it the most reliably, although sometimes it just randomly crashes too.

If there's no fix, I'm considering using a text editor for code and copy/pasting to the console or using R in terminal, which I don't really want to have to do.

Also, I keep getting this error and google doesn't turn anything up: "2015-05-01 15:36:10.131 R[2813:39837] *** WARNING: Method convertPointFromBase: in class NSView is deprecated on 10.7 and later. It should not be used in new applications." 

I don't know if that's a different question or if it's related.

Thanks for thoughts!

Mila

messages.author: 47ca46208a81ec5e
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: R Crashing in Yosemite OS X
parts:
I was having this issue a lot with R's built in editor and Yosemite, and I ultimately switched to using RStudio which gave me no further problems. The issue with the built in editor did seem to disappear when I upgraded R to 3.1.3 (though I’m not sure how it behaves with the latest version released a couple of weeks ago). Sometimes I’ll still get that Method convertPointFromBase message, so maybe something is still lurking.

In summary: RStudio was the solution.

--

I've not had an issue with Rstudio ever, but I prefer the less cluttered interface of the R.app editor. Sometimes I use TextWrangler, but I really like being able to send lines from the editor to R itself to debug.
